entities.name: Amzu
entities.description: A kraul shaman from Ravnica and former Golgari death priest, one of Vraska's most devoted followers.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Ravnican guild that Amzu broke away from, taking many kraul with her.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who was compleated and took a role in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Vraska played a role after her compleation.

entities.name: Kraul
entities.description: Insectoid people of Ravnica, many of whom followed Amzu away from the Golgari.

events.summary: Amzu refused to denounce the compleated Vraska and broke from the Golgari altogether, taking many kraul with her.
events.quote: She refused to denounce Vraska after her compleation

events.summary: Amzu refuses to leave Golgari territory and encourages the kraul to harass the Golgari.
events.quote: as Amzu relentlessly encourages the kraul to harass the Golgari

relations.note: One of Vraska's most devoted followers.
relations.quote: one of Vraska 's most devoted followers

relations.note: Breaks from the Golgari and skirmishes with them.
